title: Epidemiology and Long-term Outcome of Patients With VHD
brief_summary: Valvular heart diseases are significant problem in Polish population. Coexistence of coronary artery disease in patients with VHD increases the risk of death and affects further therapeutic strategy. The aim of the study is analysis the epidemiology and the long-term prognosis among patients with VHD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Valvular heart disease in moderate and severe stages

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years old
study_population: Patients hospitalized in Medical University of Bialystok.
